summary: Re-ran phase-3 backend tests after main agent fixes (duplicate /admin/reports/export handler removed; stricter validation added to PATCH /admin/users/{uid}/permissions, POST /admin/devices/bulk-op assign_campaign, POST /admin/earnings/payout). All 36 phase-3 tests now pass (previously 32/36). Full regression of 57 prior tests (phase 1 + 1.5 + 2) also passes. Total 93/93 backend tests green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown large (~1900+ lines); consider splitting into routers (admin, reports, devices, earnings) for maintainability.
Phase-3 export_report_v2 co-exists with older phase-2 export handlers on other paths — audit periodically to prevent regression duplication like the one just fixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend tests (93) pass. Testing scope was backend-only per request. If frontend testing is next, use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env and admin credentials above.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration had duplicate FastAPI route registrations for /admin/reports/export — FastAPI uses first-match semantics, so the older simpler handler shadowed the phase-3 handler for kinds drivers/network/revenue and for PDF format. Fix: deletion of duplicate handler at server.py:1332. Verified by re-running test_p3_D0/D1/D2 — all pass.
